title: fix(runtime): an App member's flow and permission-set copies land in its App's customization package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9G7GV4b8VVsmvnATgkpRzma)_

Fixes #31792

Claim 6732012750 (`domain:server#4`, card-thread session_01ADHkmSnvbgyL646ChBK28N); seat ruling on Step 0: option (c) accepted. Ruling record 6691022506 (an App member's pair is its App's pair). Thread-read: contract review 6731976766 on PR #31751. Round 2: contract review 6733822347 (FAIL: ③.1 must-fix, ③.6 should-fix) and the seat's ruling 6733829954 (arms (i)–(iii) are inside (c); the rule is membership in the save gate's closure).

Clause-②: yes (widening) — widened: `POST /api/v1/automation/:name/clone` with no `package` for a flow shipped by a member of an installed App, and both clone doors (`POST /api/v1/automation/:name/clone`, `POST /api/v1/security/permission-sets/:name/clone`) naming that App's pair `APP.custom` in `package`, now answer `200` and land the copy there, where they answered `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT [new_similar_target_outside_closure]`. The rule is now membership in `packageDependencyClosure(target)`, the save gate's write scope: the source's package, and for a permission set each object's owner, must be in it. Beyond the target's own declared dependencies that closure holds (i) for an App pair that declares its App, the App's members and each member's declared dependencies, transitively; (ii) for the permission-set objects check, the objects those packages own; (iii) for a target that declares a residual owner (ADR-0130 D4), that owner's declared dependencies. Every landing newly accepted is one the save into that target already accepted; nothing outside the save gate's closure is accepted. Measured on base (`56cac5eb` source) and head: the 7 App-member landing pins and the judge-before-create pin are red on base and green on head. Nothing is narrowed: the CONTROLs (a writable package that declares only the App; the pre-existing outside-closure refusals) are green on both.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：判断「复制到哪个包」的目标规则，改用元数据保存时用的同一个依赖闭包。这个闭包把 App 的定制包(APP.custom)视为能引用 App 的所有成员包。流程门在调 ensure 之前，先判断已经存在的配对定制包。
- 为什么改：App 成员包的流程点「复制到定制包」，平台按裁决把副本放进 APP.custom，但同一个接口随后又用较窄的闭包判它，于是 409。拒之前 APP.custom 已被建出，报错却说「什么都没写」。权限集显式指定 APP.custom 也被同样拒绝。
- 风险与回滚：新规则就是「来源包(及权限集授权对象的所属包)在目标的保存闸闭包内」。比原来多接受三类：App 定制包对成员及成员的依赖、权限集对这些包拥有的对象、声明了残余所有者的目标对该所有者的依赖。凡是新接受的，保存本身本来就接受;闭包外的仍 409。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/domains/new-similar-target.ts`(两处闭包读法);`automation.ts` 的 `land` 先判再建;流程测试的新 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/automation-flow-clone-custom-package.test.ts src/domains/permission-set-clone.test.ts`,预期 92 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Step 0 (readings: card-thread file `31792-step0.md`, summarised here, measured on #31751's head `b14cd22b` with its App-member rig):

| Case (single node) | main | Packages |
|---|---|---|
| App-member flow, default landing, no pair | 409 `outside_closure`, says "Nothing was written" | `APP.custom` created |
| same, `APP.custom` present | 409 `outside_closure` | unchanged |
| explicit `package: APP.custom` | 409 `outside_closure` | unchanged |
| only the member's legacy pair present | 409 `outside_closure` | `APP.custom` created |
| permission set, explicit `APP.custom`, granting on a member-owned object | 409 from the closure branch AND from the objects branch | — |

The save gate's write scope already reads `packageDependencyClosure` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, ADR-0150 D3), which widens an App's pair by its members (`widenPairClosureToAppMembers`); `newSimilarTargetRefusal` was the one reader still on the bare `resolvePackageClosure` walk, in both of its branches. Options weighed: (a) a pair arm on the closure branch (`isPairOf`) leaves the objects branch refusing the permission-set case; (b) judging against `appOf(source)` has the same gap and would also accept any writable package that declares the App but not the member. (c) was ruled.

- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/new-similar-target.ts`** — the target's closure is `packageDependencyClosure(target, registry)`, asked once and read by both the source-package branch and the objects branch: the rule is membership in the save gate's closure. The header names what that closure holds beyond the bare declared walk, arms (i)–(iii) above. A writable package that declares only the App is no pair, so it gets no member widening and stays refused (CONTROL).
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`** (`resolveCloneTarget`, `land`) — judge before create: the pair the ensure derives (`pairOf(owner, installedManifestsOf(registry))`), when already installed, is judged before the ensure is asked, so a refused landing creates nothing. An absent pair is created by the ensure writable and declaring its App; the save gate's closure of such a pair holds the App's members, the owner among them, so a creating ensure is never followed by a refusal (on a registry with `getAllPackages`, as the real `ObjectQL` registry has; nit ③.5 left as ruled). #31751's multi-replica probe keeps its place first.
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/permission-set-clone.ts`** — unchanged: its default landing never asks the closure rule (no ensure-then-judge order), and its explicit target is fixed through the shared rule.
- **`.changeset/31792-new-similar-app-pair-closure.md`** — `patch` for `@objectstack/runtime`, both declaration lines.

## Tests

In the existing harnesses, as new top-level `describe`s:

- Flow (`automation-flow-clone-custom-package.test.ts`, real `ObjectQL` + `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`): default landing with no pair → 200 into `APP.custom`, created, row bound there; with the pair present → 200, no package created; with only the legacy member pair → 200 into `APP.custom`; explicit `package: APP.custom` → 200; arm (i): a flow of a package a member declares (neither the App nor a member, its own unit) with explicit `package: APP.custom` → 200 into it; judge-before-create: an installed `APP.custom` that dropped its App dependency → 409 `outside_closure`, the ensure never called, nothing published, stored or registered, package list unchanged; CONTROL: a writable package declaring the App but not the member → 409 `outside_closure`, nothing created; CONTROL: a standalone (non-App) package's flow → 200 into its own pair.
- Permission set (`permission-set-clone.test.ts`): a member's set granting on a member-owned object, explicit `package: APP.custom` → 200, saved there; CONTROL: the App-only writable package → 409 `outside_closure`, no ensure, no save.
- **Forced edits, named:** (1) #31751's pin "a member whose App's pair this replica already serves…" asserted the multi-replica answer equals the single-node answer (both 409 on main); it now asserts 200 into `APP.custom` on both. (2) The permission-set rig's fake ensure wrote `APP.custom` declaring the MEMBER, while the real door declares the App; it now declares the App, and the fake registry gains `getAllPackages` (read by the pair widening). The fixture also gains a member-owned object, a member set granting on it, and the App-only writable package. No other existing case changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Live server: NOT MEASURED.** The triage comment asks for a live confirmation; no example app in the tree installs an App with a member shipping a flow, so the reach is the real `ObjectQL` + protocol rig above (the same registry, ensure door and save path a server composes).
- **The legacy member pair.** With `MEMBER.custom` installed, the default landing still goes to `APP.custom` (where the ensure lands it, `pairOf`); naming `MEMBER.custom` explicitly was and stays admitted (it declares the member).
- **Message text unchanged.** The `outside_closure` sentence ("declares no dependency on …") stays true for every target it can still refuse.

## Verification

Head `93e41148` (fix `b6543cc3`, tests `9215b614`, changeset `d4f1efa3`, round-2 text and arm (i) pin `93e41148`), cut on `origin/main` `56cac5eb` (after #31751 landed as `41106b51`); `main` has since moved 12 commits, none touching a file this PR changes or the closure and pair modules it reads.

<details><summary>Suites (os-verify-lock, VERDICT command-exit 0 unless stated)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: 565 files / 9155 passed, 19 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0 (the first attempt reached `check:test-typecheck` with `@objectstack/driver-turso` unbuilt, which is outside the `runtime^...` build closure, so an untouched file reported TS2307; green after building it).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` (full battery, after the `dogfood^...` closure build): 441 passed, 3 skipped files / 3662 passed, 42 skipped tests.
- Lint (`eslint --no-inline-config packages/runtime/src`): exit 0.
- Base leg: the two edited suites run against `56cac5eb`'s `automation.ts` and `new-similar-target.ts` (restored from `HEAD` after; `git diff HEAD` empty): 7 failed / 84 passed, the 7 being exactly the six App-member landing pins and the judge-before-create pin; every CONTROL green. Round 2 (`93e41148`): the arm (i) pin red on base too (the `-t 'save gate'` run: 7 red / 4 green, the 4 being the CONTROLs and unchanged cases it selects).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (negative pins)</summary>

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `9215b614`; the tests import the runtime from `src`, so no rebuild leg. Each restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

- `ABLATED_31792`: the closure read without the pair widening (`packageDependencyClosure` handed a registry with no `getAllPackages`, i.e. the bare walk). 6 of 91 red: the five flow App-member landing pins and the permission-set explicit `APP.custom` pin. Every CONTROL green. Re-run on `93e41148`: 7 of 92 red, the arm (i) pin added.
- `ABLATED_31792_ORDER`: the judge-before-ensure guard removed. 1 of 91 red: the judge-before-create pin.
- `ABLATED_31792_WIDEN`: the forbidden widening put back (the target's closure always includes the source's package). 5 of 91 red: both new CONTROLs, the two pre-existing outside-closure refusals (flow and permission set), and the judge-before-create pin.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `d4f1efa3`: 70 families, each run with stdin closed. `--ran` reconciliation: "70 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". First pass: three exited 3 on prerequisites (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` needed unbuilt packages); each re-ran exit 0 after the prerequisite.

</details>
